title: THE GUN CARD STANDS IN THE RIGHT COLUMN
why: The HUD spec of 2026-10-15 (decision 5): one card slot in the right column, standing on the gear readout. Since v27.17 the card always stepped left of the right column, into the field beside the player. It now stands at the right edge on the gear readout, under the info panel, and steps left of the column only when a long contract list makes the panel reach down to the top of the card.
now: The gun card now stands at the right edge on the gear readout when the info panel leaves room.
